title: maxMlsObjectSize 4 MiB cannot be met at the protocol relay
description: Findings log F10 as built (48f5e33): maxMlsObjectSize = 4 MiB as Mark decided, but the relay and /notify cap a whole protocol body at MAX_BODY_LEN = 4 MiB (decision mimid-1wgh.6.8). A Room/send message within ~100 octets of 4 MiB is refused at the relay (SubmitMessageRequest envelope), and a Commit near 4 MiB cannot be fanned out (FanoutMessage envelope). Options: advertise MAX_BODY_LEN minus an envelope allowance (e.g. 4 MiB - 64 KiB), or raise MAX_BODY_LEN to 4 MiB + 64 KiB. Needs Mark: changes the advertised number or a provider-to-provider limit.
close_reason: Done in 3a672fc (branch f10-limit): maxMlsObjectSize = MAX_BODY_LEN - 64 KiB envelope allowance (4128768), MAX_BODY_LEN kept at 4 MiB; e2e test at the limit and one octet over.
